mandate: C378 — test the cross-sectional intraday VOLATILITY-OF-VOLATILITY RATIO (VOVR) x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. VOVR scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 bars ending at bar t (trailing returns X=r[t-W+1..t]), split into NB=16 contiguous blocks of BL=16 bars: brv_j=sum(x^2) per block; m=mean(brv), sd=std(brv); vovr_cv=sd/max(m,1e-12) (cross-sub-block RV dispersion); vovr_trend=(OLS slope of brv_j on j)/max(m,1e-12) (early-vs-late volatility shift). Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (vovr_cv_dev, vovr_trend_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs/denominator requirements (t<W-1=255).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 bars ending at t (trailing returns X=r[t-W+1..t]), split into NB=16 blocks of BL=16 bars: brv_j=sum(x^2) per block; m=mean(brv), sd=std(brv); vovr_cv=sd/max(m,1e-12); vovr_trend=(OLS slope of brv_j on j)/max(m,1e-12).
methodology.signals: vovr_cv/vovr_trend over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.vovr_vectorization_note: VOVR uses sliding_window_view(sq, BL) with strided indexing to gather the 16 non-overlapping block sums ending at each bar — no Python loop over bars x assets — validated against brute force in tests.
